notes.title: Day 2 Update
notes.content:
-Fixed sidejump bug in Acropolis zone
-Fixed an issue with saving through the Quit to Desktop button
-Fixed some UI scaling issues.

notes.title: 1st day Update
notes.content:
-Fixed some minor bugs
-Made the first stages of the game slightly easier
-Added visual feedback for Sidejump pads

notes.title: Emanate Demo Major Update
notes.content: A major update for the Emanate Demo, greatly improved from the original demo version. Now is the perfect time to try out Emanate if you haven't already!

notes.title: Emanate Demo - Developer Speedrun Livestream - Steam NEXT FEST
notes.content: Welcome to the Emanate Demo! In this livestream I will take you through Emanate in it's current state, showing you how the game works and what you can expect. Feel free to ask any questions.
